newsitem.title: UK: EBRD meeting evacuated because of fire alarm.
newsitem.headline: EBRD meeting evacuated because of fire alarm.

text.p: The annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) was interrupted by a fire alarm in London's historic Guildhall on Monday and police ordered the evacuation of the building. "There is a fire evacuation in progress," one policeman told reporters.
EBRD Chairman Ruairi Quinn, the Irish finance minister, asked delegates to leave.
"A fire alarm has gone off. Please make an orderly exit to the yard. We will resume at 3 o'clock. Sorry for the disruption," he said.
The EBRD, set up in 1991 to help former Soviet bloc countries make the transition to market economies, had earlier begun its two-day annual meeting.
Preliminary weekend events, including seminars and business presentations, were marred by long queues for admission and overcrowding in meeting rooms at a separate venue in the City of London.
